availability_overrides_hours_check.name: availability_overrides_hours_check
availability_overrides_hours_check.value: "availability_overrides"."is_closed" or ("availability_overrides"."start_time" is not null and "availability_overrides"."end_time" is not null and "availability_overrides"."end_time" > "availability_overrides"."start_time")

shoot_inspo_content_check.name: shoot_inspo_content_check
shoot_inspo_content_check.value: ("shoot_inspo"."type" in ('image', 'video') and "shoot_inspo"."blob_url" is not null and "shoot_inspo"."blob_pathname" is not null) or ("shoot_inspo"."type" = 'link' and "shoot_inspo"."link_url" is not null) or "shoot_inspo"."type" = 'note'

shoots_kind_fields_check.name: shoots_kind_fields_check
shoots_kind_fields_check.value: ("shoots"."kind" = 'booking' and "shoots"."booking_id" is not null) or ("shoots"."kind" = 'styled' and "shoots"."booking_id" is null and "shoots"."date" is not null)
